standard_prerequisites.name: Summands of objects with a dual have a dual
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Homology, the lemma that a summand of an object admitting a left dual again admits one
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the statement from an arbitrary motive to a twisted motive of a smooth projective scheme.

standard_prerequisites.name: Twisting an object providing a dual
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The construction of the twist as the tensor product with the Tate object, together with the categorical lemma that tensoring with an object admitting a dual preserves the existence of duals
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the statement from a twisted motive to the untwisted motive of the scheme.

standard_prerequisites.name: Additivity of duals and duality of the motive of an equidimensional scheme
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Homology, the lemma on duals of direct sums, and Same chapter, the lemma exhibiting the twisted motive of an equidimensional smooth projective scheme as a left dual of its motive
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces to the irreducible components, where the duality statement applies.

core_obligations: Reduce to a twisted motive (proof lines 1241-1246): an arbitrary motive is a summand of the twisted motive of a smooth projective scheme, and a summand of an object with a left dual has a left dual.

Remove the twist (proof lines 1246-1250): the twisted motive is the tensor product of the motive of the scheme with the Tate object, whose negative twist is a left dual, so by the categorical lemma it suffices to show that the motive of the scheme has a left dual.

Reduce to components (proof lines 1250-1256): the motive of the scheme is the direct sum of the motives of its irreducible components, duals are compatible with direct sums, and each of those motives is equidimensional, so the duality statement applies to each summand and the proof is complete.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a twisted motive of a scheme using summands.
Remove the twist using the dual of the Tate object.
Split into irreducible components and apply the duality statement.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that every object of the category of motives has a left dual (statement lines 1237-1239). The proof (proof lines 1240-1256) reduces to twisted motives of smooth projective schemes, removes the twist, and splits into irreducible components where the duality statement for equidimensional schemes applies. H2: a complete three step reduction.
